boundaryNotes.detail: z.nullable(), and any union carrying z.null(), rejects an absent key; a `T?` field accepts it. This is the declared undefined-to-null interop normalization.
z.optional() rejects an explicit null; `T?` accepts it. This is the declared undefined-to-null interop normalization.
z.strictObject rejects an unknown key; a VelarScript record accepts the value and drops the key. The generated type is wider than the zod schema for surplus fields.
